area: Builders: the remaining day-to-day edits on Bulk changes (ZIA activation, URL categories, IP groups, DLP dictionaries and engines, ZIdentity users, one Private Service Edge)
title: Admin editors on the shared engine: Scope rule, four gates, plan hash, re-read, read-back, Undo or a stated no-Undo, audit with actor, a temporary password shown once

checks.what: ZIA activation: the plan reads GET /status and lists it; PENDING asks ACTIVATE every time; ACTIVE and INPROGRESS are refused; an unreadable or unknown status is unknown, never pending

ZIA activation: without the phrase, write mode or the assessor nothing is sent; activated meanwhile gives plan_changed or a re-read conflict; the run's audit entry and the record name the actor; no Undo, said in the preview
URL category rename and delete: sent back as read; a delete is refused while a rule names the category (rules listed) and needs DELETE <name>; Undo re-creates it with its URLs

DLP dictionaries and engines: expression parsed and explained, ZIA limits and ReDoS guard, re-read conflict, Undo; a change to what an enabled DLP rule detects (or rules that cannot be checked) asks APPLY <n> CHANGES
IP groups: source group edit, delete while unused with DELETE <name>, CSV import capped and parsed defensively, export cells spreadsheet-safe

ZIdentity user edit (display name, names, email, department, groups) sent back as read, read back, undone; reset and skip MFA are a raw call to ZIdentity's public API behind the assessor and RESET <login>; a temporary password is in no result, job log, audit entry or record, before or after its one reveal
Every new type is in the secure-defaults table (test_sbd_writes DEFAULT_OFF) with why it creates nothing enforcing

findings.title: During development: the five admin types added first were not in the secure-defaults table, so test_sbd_writes failed for each
findings.fix: each type listed in DEFAULT_OFF with its reason

findings.title: During development: a DLP dictionary or engine edit that changes what an enabled rule detects did not ask the typed phrase
findings.fix: ops_dlp_objects.live_users finds the enabled rules (through engines for a dictionary); unknown counts as used; APPLY <n> CHANGES is asked

findings.title: During development: the ZIdentity user edit could not change the email the spec names
findings.fix: primary_email (the SDK model's field) is checked, sent back with the user as read, read back and undone

notes: Verified against zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3: zia/activate.py status (GET /status) and activate (POST /status/activate); zid/users.py update_user and the UserRecord field primary_email.

Assumed (marked in the code): ZIA's activation status values ACTIVE, PENDING and INPROGRESS; that an activation makes every pending change live, whoever saved it; ZIdentity's POST /users/{id}:resetpassword and /users/{id}:setskipmfa paths and body, from Zscaler's published API reference.
